statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain header 'Act Nos, 9 of 1950 39 of 1954 22 of 1955 28 of 1964 20 of 1969 48 of 1971 8 of 1979 13 of 1986'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py into a 73-section tree with 7 parts, 9 definitions and 4 source footnotes. Other sources inspected: the FAOLEX text-layer PDF of Cap. 295 (chain to 8 of 1979), used as the verification source; the legacy section index (68 sections); the registry's markdown path, which is not on disk; every held amending file, whose title pages were read from the scans. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 13 of 1986. Review performed: all 73 section numbers located as section starts in the FAOLEX print; section 45 compared in full between the two editions (the only wording difference found is the 13 of 1986 proviso, absent from FAOLEX); marginal notes read for sections 41, 43, 53, 54 and 65 and the HTML headings corrected to them with the raw reading kept; validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and every remaining warning is documented in the trees. Not read word for word throughout. Amendment coverage: 8 instruments known (7 in the HTML chain plus 16 of 1986 from the curriculum); 7 held in some form, 39 of 1954 not held; all chain instruments are already incorporated in the baseline and nothing was applied. Trees included for 13 of 1986, 20 of 1969 and 8 of 1979 (HTML); their `amends` was filled from their long titles. 16 of 1986 held is an incorporation Act and is excluded. Structural weaknesses: the HTML marker '[ 7, 28 of 1961]' on section 21(3A) is almost certainly a misprint for 28 of 1964; the amending trees carry inserted sections as sibling nodes; the 68-section index lacks 11, 20, 41, 62 and 38A, which explains the 68-versus-73 count. Missing sources: Act No. 39 of 1954; a Government Printer text of the principal Act; any post-1986 amendment, none of which is known from held sources. Unresolved questions: whether any Act No. 16 of 1986 amends this statute; the 28 of 1961 marker. Lawyer verification: unverified.
